subject: Mathematical Literacy
pacing_note: The IEB publishes no ATP equivalent; term placement and week spans are the DBE ATP pacing carried over as a default. IEB schools set their own pacing — treat weeks as advisory.
assessment_note: DBE SBA programmes, control-test scopes and exam structures are deliberately stripped: IEB assessment is specified by the IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines (see ../exam_guidelines/), which have not been ingested yet. Do not fall back to the CAPS exam_structure for IEB papers.
scope_deltas: SAG-stated content-scope differences vs the CAPS/DBE prescription are recorded in scope_deltas.json in this folder (hand-maintained, SAG-transcribed only; an empty ledger means 'not yet transcribed', never 'no differences').

topics.name: NUMBERS AND CALCULATIONS WITH NUMBERS
subtopics: Number formats: decimal point/comma, thousand separators; positive and negative numbers in context; conversions between number formats (dozen, century, etc.)
Operations with whole numbers and decimals with/without a calculator (BODMAS); squares, cubes and square roots; operations with fractions
Rounding (to decimal places, nearest whole, up or down); ratios; rates (meaning, types, calculations); direct and inverse proportion; percentages incl. increase and decrease

topics.name: PATTERNS RELATIONSHIPS & REPRESENTATIONS
subtopics: Patterns and relationships: constant, direct-proportion and inverse-proportion relationships; input/output tables
Representations: tables with dependent and independent variables, equations, graphs
Interpreting tables and graphs: zero, minimum, maximum and missing values; write a story from a graph and draw a graph from a story
topics.prior_knowledge: Number patterns; basic knowledge of graphs

topics.name: DATA HANDLING
subtopics: Developing questions; collecting data
Classifying and organising data
Summarising data: mean, median, mode, range; analysing data represented by these

topics.name: FINANCE
subtopics: Financial documents: household bills, shopping documents, banking documents, household budgets; terminology
Tariff systems: municipal, telephone, transport tariffs and bank fees; cost calculations via tariff and/or formula; drawing and interpreting tariff graphs

topics.name: MEASUREMENT
subtopics: Conversions: metric system, conversion factors and tables; time formats and conversions (sec to decades)
Measuring and estimating: length, distance, weight/mass, volume, temperature, time; calculating costs of products and services

topics.name: MAPS, PLANS & OTHER REPRESENTATIONS
subtopics: Scale: 1:500 and bar scales; actual distance and length from map/plan measurements
Maps: describing position relative to surroundings, finding location, following and developing directions, direction indicators, house numbering, stadium seat numbering

topics.name: PROBABILITY
subtopics: Expression of probability; events, outcomes and prediction
Relative frequency and theoretical probability of an event
Tree diagrams and two-way tables

topics.name: FINANCE
subtopics: Income, expenditure, profit and loss; fixed, variable and occasional values from financial documents; analyse and prepare income-and-expenditure statements and budgets
Interest vs interest rate; calculate both (without formulae)
Taxation: VAT in shop purchases, till slips and bills; VAT-inclusive and -exclusive prices
Banking, loans and investments: banking terminology, bank charges per account type, graphs from bank charges
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 8-9 financial maths; percentage calculations; introduction to VAT

topics.name: MEASUREMENTS
subtopics: Perimeter and area of rectangles, triangles and circles (quarter, semi, three-quarter) using provided formulae
Cost-of-products problems, tasks and projects
topics.prior_knowledge: Gr 8-9 Maths; substitution in formulae; interpretation of graphs

topics.name: MAPS, PLANS & OTHER REPRESENTATIONS
subtopics: Floor plans and design: symbols and notation, describing what is represented, analysing layouts and suggesting alternatives, actual lengths via scale, material quantities via perimeter/area/volume, drawing 2D floor plans of familiar structures
Assembly diagrams
Models: packaging cans/boxes for optimal space; most cost-effective packaging
topics.prior_knowledge: Exposure to basic floor plans and model instructions

topics.name: DATA HANDLING
subtopics: Representing data: pie charts (interpretation only), histograms, single bar graphs, line and broken-line graphs
Analysing data represented by these graphs

caps_notes: CAPS p.15: concepts must not be taught in the absence of contexts - learners must meet them in realistic scenarios
